plain_language: Launched under the Big Results Now programme to improve facility performance.
Sets the '90-70-90 by 2030' targets, which makes the 7.7% screening figure especially stark.
Trained teams start scoring 2,583 facilities across 10 regions.
Data collection completed; National Census 2022 counts the 10 regions at ~17.5 million people.
The SDG goals for maternal, newborn and under-5 mortality, plus the WHO target to eliminate cervical cancer.
